name: IRONLINE / starter top

tier_notes.parts: Foundation sprite assets: complete family; art review ready.
tier_notes.animations: Authored prototype timing and deformation. Hero contact frame and loop polishing remain appropriate in later animation task. Ring-out cel elevation is visual only; world movement supplied by simulation.
tier_notes.combinations: 48 QA composites, generated from independent component layers, not redraws.

assembly_rules: Place cell origin at screen contact point minus [24,40].
Draw shadow, bit, ratchet, blade, then FX.
Set Blade vertical offset from Ratchet selection. Bits share socket [24,35].
For lean use paired Blade and Ratchet cels, keeping Bit contact near pivot.
No whole-sprite image rotation; spinning is authored in the projected world plane.
Render using nearest-neighbour at integral scale; no filtering or mipmaps.
